correctness.rationale: Positive radial normal parameter makes the pedal a simple analytic curve. Curvature numerator has an exact symbolic checked polynomial form; monotonicity of \(2ex/(1+ex^2)\) locates the global minimum, then factorization and the endpoint evaluation give the necessary and sufficient interval and all boundary cases. The 300 numerical cases are supplementary only; the analytic proof is uniform in the entire quantified domain.
